v47_primary_source_bullets: Execute Pull-Brake-Under-Slide (PBUS) belaying so the brake hand never leaves the rope and locks below the belay device.
Station an attentive backup belayer holding the dead rope 3 to 5 feet behind the primary belayer on every climb.
